newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST-Wide range for Neste 8-mth profit.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Wide range for Neste 8-mth profit.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 295 million markka median forecast for oil and energy group Neste Oy's January-August profit after financial items, before extraordinaries.
The results are due on October 11 at 0900/0600 GMT. @
In January-August 1995, Neste posted a 1.14 billion markka profit.
For Neste's full-year 1996 profit, nine of the 11 analysts polled gave a median forecast of 631 million markka (mean 680 million) in a 294-1,078 million markka range.

On July 26, Neste said unexpectedly high crude oil prices had led to a sales margin deficit of 285 million markka in crude oil trading, but that its performance since April had followed the trend anticipated in its January-April interim report released in June. @
In June, Neste said profitability on its own operations would improve although this did not necessarily mean an overall improvement in group profit after financial items.
Neste's 1995 profit before extraordinary items was 1.36 billion markka.
The data was collected in the first two weeks of October.
Contributors to the survey were Aktia Bank, Alfred Berg, AG Private Bankers, Aros, Erik Selin, Evli Securities, Handelsbanken, Interbank, Merita Securities, Opstock and Postipankki.
